title: The Gauntlet

story.briefing: The last diagnostic before the Core. A window of readings is admissible while it carries no more than k distinct values — find the longest admissible window in the whole stream.
story.success: Diagnostic passed. The Core acknowledges you and opens.

description:
Given an array of readings and a limit k, return the length of the longest contiguous stretch containing at most k distinct values. If k is 0, the answer is 0. An empty array returns 0.

This level requires linear time.
hints: A window that is admissible stays admissible when it shrinks, so the left edge never needs to move backwards. That is what keeps this to a single pass.
You need the count of each value in the window, not merely the set — a value leaving on the left only stops being distinct when its count reaches zero.

Extend the right edge, adding each value to a count map. While the map holds more than k entries, remove values from the left edge and delete them when their count hits zero. Record the width after every step.
